description: Adds a product to a WhatsApp number (connection_id and name), or changes one when id is given. A product has photos (ids of files uploaded on its number; the first is the cover), variants (a name, a price and a SKU each), price tiers (a quantity and its price, e.g. 3 for 1500), a currency (ISO 4217; left out, the workspace’s), a short description of 1 to 3 lines, details, stock (in_stock, low or out_of_stock, with an optional count), a delivery note, tags, a SKU, whether it is switched on, and approved answers (a question and its answer). Prices are written in digits, like "590" or "12.50". Each call needs a confirmed call: without confirmation_token the call is a preview that returns what would happen and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it writes. Returns the product.

answers.description: Questions and the answers the business approved. Only these are ever sent automatically. Written whole.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

connection_id.description: The number the product belongs to. Optional with an API key made for one number, which already names it.

currency.description: ISO 4217. Null uses the workspace’s currency (PATCH /v1/organizations/{id}).

id.description: The product to change, by its prd_ id. Left out, a new product is added.

photos.description: Up to 10 photos, by the id POST /v1/media gave each (image/jpeg or image/png, uploaded on the product’s number). The first is the cover. Written whole: the list replaces the one before.

price_tiers.description: The price of a quantity, e.g. 1 for 590 and 3 for 1500. Each quantity once. Written whole.

short_description.description: 1 to 3 lines, shown on the product card.

variants.description: Sizes, flavours or colours, each with its own price and SKU. Written whole.

name: upsert_product
title: Add or change a product
